name: The Quack Council
tagline: A council of five rubber ducks with distinct voices gives advice, tuned by your heart rate and blood pressure.
problem: Talking problems through out loud helps, as rubber-duck debugging shows, but people lack a patient listener.
solution: Users speak or type their worries; a sensing SDK estimates heart rate and blood pressure to set the tone, and five duck personas answer in their own voices.
demo_moment: Team-described: vent to the council and hear five ducks respond in turn.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 82 submissions.
Extends a known engineering ritual (rubber-duck debugging) to emotional support.

lessons: Distinct voices for each agent make a multi-agent demo legible and fun.
